shortDesc.message: Upwork toolkit: AI proposal generator, instant job alerts, proposal scoring & analysis, ROI tracker. Save connects, win more jobs.

storeDesc.message:
🚀 UpKit is an Upwork Chrome extension and toolkit for freelancers who want to find jobs faster, write proposals smarter, and track results. Stop refreshing feeds — let the Upwork job alerts come to you.

Every minute counts on the platform. The earlier you apply, the higher your chances. UpKit works as an Upwork monitoring tool that scans job feeds in the background and delivers instant job alerts the moment a relevant posting appears.


💡 Key Features

1️⃣ Upwork job alerts & notifications
Set up saved searches with keywords, budget, and client filters. UpKit sends Upwork instant job alerts and job notifications straight to your browser — no need to refresh the page. Get every Upwork new job notification within minutes of posting. Be among the first to apply and increase your response rate.

2️⃣ AI proposal generator for Upwork
UpKit is an Upwork proposal generator that creates personalized cover letters based on your profile and the job description. The built-in proposal writer drafts tailored pitches in seconds — just click "Generate Draft" on the apply page. Also works as an Upwork cover letter generator and proposal maker for any job type.

3️⃣ Proposal scoring & analysis
Built-in Upwork proposal analyzer scores your drafts on a 0–100 scale before you submit. Get feedback on hook strength, relevance, credibility, and tone. Upwork proposal scoring helps you understand what works and improve over time. Think of it as your personal proposal analysis tool that catches weak spots before the client does.

4️⃣ AI job scoring & client evaluation
Not every job is worth your connects. UpKit rates each posting based on:
- client payment verification and spend history
- hire rate and review rating
- budget and description quality
- country and project scope signals

Focus on jobs that actually convert. Skip low-quality postings and save your connects for the right opportunities.

5️⃣ ROI tracker & proposal analytics
Track every proposal you submit — view rate, shortlist rate, interviews, hires. The built-in ROI tracker shows your cost per connect and which job categories bring returns. Full proposal analytics and Upwork job tracker in one dashboard. Understand your freelance performance at a glance.


📌 How it works

1. Install the Upwork toolkit from Chrome Web Store
2. Sign in and create saved searches with your target keywords
3. UpKit monitors the job feed every 1–4 minutes
4. New matching jobs appear in the side panel with a score
5. Open a job, generate a proposal draft with AI, review, and submit

The Upwork automation tool runs quietly in the background — even when you are working in another tab. No manual refreshing needed.


➤ Who is UpKit for?

- Freelancers looking for an Upwork job alert chrome extension
- Professionals who need an Upwork proposal writer and AI drafting assistant
- Anyone who wants to track proposal performance and connects ROI
- Remote workers tired of manually refreshing the job feed
- Freelancers who want Upwork AI tools to speed up applications


📊 What makes UpKit different?

▸ Real-time Upwork job notifications — not daily digests
▸ AI proposal generator + proposal scoring in one extension
▸ Client trust scoring so you don’t waste connects
▸ Works directly on upwork.com — no separate app needed
▸ Lightweight chrome extension for Upwork, no impact on browser performance


⚙️ Easy setup

Getting started takes under 2 minutes:
- install the Upwork tools extension from Chrome Web Store
- sign in with your account
- create your first saved search for job alerts
- fill in your freelancer profile for AI proposal drafts

UpKit works in the Chrome side panel — stays visible while you browse jobs without interrupting your workflow.


❓ Frequently asked questions

Q: Does UpKit send proposals automatically?
A: No. UpKit generates draft proposals for your review. You always control what gets submitted.

Q: How often does UpKit check for new jobs?
A: Every 1 to 4 minutes. The Upwork job feed tracker runs in the background automatically.

Q: Is UpKit an Upwork bot?
A: No. UpKit is an Upwork assistant chrome extension that helps you draft and analyze — it does not auto-submit or auto-bid.

Q: Does the proposal generator work for all job types?
A: Yes — hourly and fixed-price jobs are both supported. You can generate Upwork proposal drafts with custom prompts.

Q: Is my data safe?
A: UpKit only accesses pages you visit on upwork.com. Your profile and freelancer data are stored locally on your device.
